pages.text: Fills and empties canisters, 1,000 mB at a time. Put an **empty canister** (liquids) or **gas canister** (gases) in and it fills from the **supply tank** on the left; put a filled canister in and it is poured into the **catch tank** on the right. Draws 20 FE a tick.

Pipes and buckets fill the supply tank; pipes, buckets and auto-eject drain the catch tank. It works for every fluid that has a canister, so a line of them can bottle a [Chemical Plant](processing/chemical_plant)'s output for later use.
